We simulate 400 noise realisations with a Welch estimator.
The bias vanishes for long segments, and the estimator is therefore consistent.
\begin{equation}
  b = \frac{c}{N} \label{eq:bias}
\end{equation}
This suggests that the method may extend to coloured noise.
Smith reports a bias below 1\% in comparable settings~\cite{smith2020}.
We expect the estimator to stay unbiased in practice.
\begin{thebibliography}{1}
\bibitem{smith2020} A. Smith, Estimators of noise, J. Stat. 12 (2020) 1.
\end{thebibliography}
